name: Dubai

meta.title: Study in Dubai from India: international campuses close to home
meta.description: Dubai has 37 international university campuses regulated by KHDA, a short flight from most Indian cities. What to check before you apply, and how Wayfarer helps.

summary: Degrees from international universities with campuses in Dubai, a short flight from Bengaluru, Chennai and Kochi.

whyReasons.text: 37 of Dubai's 41 private higher education institutions are international campuses, so you can earn a degree from a UK, Australian or Indian university while living in Dubai.
International students make up 35% of students at Dubai's private universities, and their number rose 29% in a year.
Business, information technology, engineering, media and design are the most popular subjects.

faq.a: Check that the university is licensed by KHDA (the Knowledge and Human Development Authority). KHDA publishes a directory of licensed institutions. Your counsellor will also check how the degree is treated in India for your plans.

faq.q: Which universities have campuses in Dubai?
faq.a: 37 of the 41 institutions regulated by KHDA are international campuses, including universities from the UK, Australia and India. Ask your counsellor for a shortlist that fits your course and budget.
